integrity: A self-contained characteristic-free support lemma proves the count and rank law; 24 exhaustive finite-field instances corroborated it but are not the unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Only permutation structure matrices with unit coefficients; no assertion for weighted or general perfect evolution algebras. A broader Hom-classification under another formulation might cover the statement. Independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Complete homomorphism counts and rank distributions for permutation evolution algebras
